title: Procurement Vendor Manager Indirect Category
full_description:
Amsterdam, Netherlands
€6.500,60 - €10.389,47
At ING, procurement is about collaboration, innovation, and creating strategic impact that drives sustainable growth. We are a global organization in the CFO domain with a presence in more than 20 countries. We embed responsible practices, and deliver solutions that touch every part of the organization. If you thrive in a dynamic environment, approach challenges with curiosity, and want to help shape what’s next, this is your opportunity to make a real difference.
The teamProcurement Netherlands is led by the Head of Procurement (HOP) and forms part of the Group Procurement organization. The function maximizes the value ING gets from suppliers and safeguards the integrity of our supply chain, operating efficiently and with sustainability at the heart of everything we do. We enable business partners to realize future changes and contribute to ING’s strategic goals by:
Understanding business demand and helping stakeholders choose solutions that fit.
Selecting and managing qualified suppliers for high-impact outcomes.
Acting in full compliance with internal and external regulators.
Change, renewal, and transformation are in our DNA, with a single goal: delivering the best customer experience.
Join us if you want to be part of the next chapter of our procurement journey at ING.
Roles and responsibilities
The Vendor Manager is responsible for the execution of the Source-to-Contract processes, specifically the contract Life Cycle Management activities on a strategic level and must ensure that the process always runs seamlessly. Responsible for developing the vendor plans containing clear objectives, important (contractual) focus areas, development items to support value creation and continuous improvement. Ensure accomplishment of the defined objectives as included in the vendor plan, manages and monitors the vendor performance (commercially and third-party risk), monitors completion of contract obligations, negotiating contracts and disputes. Responsible to manage critical and strategic assigned contracts in close alignment with Business Contract Owner.
Your key responsibilities include:
For assigned categories, identify business needs, category specifications and requirements as input for category plans.
Advise category manager with the development of category strategies, approaches and improvement areas.
Analysing of spend data, benchmark suppliers, track procurement performance and help to deliver value through insightful reporting and impactful work.
Identify business needs, category specifications and requirements as input for sourcing projects.
Responsible for developing the sourcing event and the management of the RFX process. Prepare sourcing documentation and train suppliers, design and issue the RFX and consolidate RFX responses.
Conduct contract negotiations with suppliers. Agree and document terms & conditions and finalize the approved contract.
Manage contract approvals and start onboarding process and content creation. Send the contract to the supplier and retrieve signatures from both parties. Provide input for the Back Office team with performing KYS checks and onboarding suppliers.
Support the Procurement Operations team with approving and reviewing vendor master data. Provide all information to operational tools during the supplier onboarding process and support contract management with supplier phase-out.
Provide input for the Leadership team with evaluating available supplier innovations and strategies. Function as a senior sourcing SME and possess deep category knowledge to execute complex sourcing initiatives for assigned categories.
Providing support to the category managers for business partnering activities, such as establishing stakeholder relationships, managing strategic initiatives, managing business innovations and assessing innovation opportunities.
Support category managers with identifying suppliers in scope during supplier segmentations. Support category management with proposal negotiations and selecting suppliers.
Drive contract and third-party risk compliance.
Execute complex sourcing initiatives and projects, communicate and advise senior stakeholders and manage global projects.
Strategic challenges:
Manage sourcing projects in the context of a multi-disciplinary stakeholder landscape consisting of business contract owner(s), multiple support functions, and Supplier by finding the optimal balance between value add, flexibility, and third-party risk management.
How to succeedWe hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself.
Bring the right mix of experience, expertise, and mindset to make an impact:
3-6 years in procurement area, preferably at strategic level and preferably in an international financial services provider organisation.
Experience with purchasing on larger sourcing and contracting projects on Facility Management, included Real Estate and Workplace services.
Experience working with offshore teams.
Master English business language/communication perfectly (spoken as well as written). Dutch language required for role.
Proven track record in delivering procurement value.
Strategic mindset: develop best in class sourcing strategies with involvement of business stakeholders.
Supplier and contract management experience
Experience and local NL market knowledge in the Indirect Category, Marcom, Facility, Travel and Car lease
Strong Project management and analytical skills.
Influencing and conflict resolution skills.
Agile and self-driven
Drive sustainable procurement.
We want to make sure that it’s possible for you to strike the right balance between your career and your private life. You can find out more about our employment conditionshere.
